description:
Install (enable) one or more Odoo modules on a LIVE database, resolving any missing Python
    dependency automatically. Odoo refuses to enable a module whose external Python dependency is
    absent ("external dependency is not met: No module named X"); this installs the modules and, when
    that error comes back, installs the named library (apt python3-<x>, else pip) and RETRIES - up to a
    few rounds - then restarts Odoo. Use it to add apps after go-live (especially Enterprise apps like
    documents, sign, web_studio, planning) so the user never meets the raw Odoo dependency error.
    Preview first (dry_run), then confirm.
name: app_install
